Create a medieval farm town in a rugged mountain basin, with a dense fortified settlement in the rocky northern half and open farmland to the south. Pack roughly sixty to eighty one- and two-story timber-and-stone buildings inside and around rectangular town walls, with orange-brown roofs, narrow lanes, courtyards, canals, bridges, and square gate towers. Outside, scatter cottages, sheds, tents, carts, fenced fields, orchards, livestock enclosures, and wooden windmills. Run turquoise streams along both sides of the town into pools and beneath footbridges, with small waterfalls among surrounding rocks. Add isolated lookout buildings on peaks, sparse trees, and grassy paths, preserving the contrast between crowded town and open agricultural outskirts.

Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density
and arrangement the description calls for. Budget is 800 tool calls and 180
minutes; every tool result reports how much of both you have spent. Spend as

clauses.text: Create a medieval farm town in a rugged mountain basin, with a dense fortified settlement in the rocky northern half and open farmland to the south

Pack roughly sixty to eighty one- and two-story timber-and-stone buildings inside and around rectangular town walls, with orange-brown roofs, narrow lanes, courtyards, canals, bridges, and square gate towers
Outside, scatter cottages, sheds, tents, carts, fenced fields, orchards, livestock enclosures, and wooden windmills
Run turquoise streams along both sides of the town into pools and beneath footbridges, with small waterfalls among surrounding rocks
Add isolated lookout buildings on peaks, sparse trees, and grassy paths, preserving the contrast between crowded town and open agricultural outskirts
